<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 224.1201, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 223.1128 Da. The formula that matches this mass most closely is C₁₆H₁₅O (exact mass 223.1123 Da, within a few ppm). No other hetero‑atoms are required to fit the observed mass.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H15O</final_answer>
